description: Annual COVID-era product revenues (COVID vaccines & major COVID therapeutics) showing how a handful of pharma companies exploded into the billions in 2021 — then watched the cash rush evaporate. Real revenues, real spikes, and a dramatic fall from the pandemic peak. Timeline: 2007–2026 (Billions USD).
youtube_description:
They came, they vaccinated, they cashed in — and then the money left. This chart race follows annual COVID-era product revenues (vaccines + major COVID therapeutics) from 2007 to 2026. Watch Moderna explode overnight, Pfizer become the pandemic titan, AstraZeneca and J&J hold smaller but vital shares, and Novavax surge briefly as supply and contracts shifted. The peak was 2021; by 2024–2026 pandemic product sales are a shadow of the jackpot years. 

Sources: company SEC filings, annual reports and official product revenue disclosures (company COVID-vaccine product splits for reported years). Numbers shown in billions USD. 

If you want more timeline deep-dives like this (and the data file for your own chart race), hit Subscribe, like the video, and tell us which industry we should chart next in the comments.
